# `assets/import/PlyImporter.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/import/PlyImporter.js`

engine/assets/import/PlyImporter.js — Stanford PLY (ASCII + binary LE) → EngineModel.  PLY is a point/mesh utility format. We read the vertex element (position + optional normal/color) and the face element (triangulated), producing one indexed primitive. Big-endian binary is uncommon for web assets and is not supported here (the editor can flag it).
